purpose: Map each final paper panel to its registered raw simulation or estimator-data generator without changing the analysis protocol.

panels.Fig2b_c: complete 55-area threshold-linear network; explicit nonlinear Heun; stable-node and zero-input-correlation ensembles
panels.Fig2f_g: complete 55-area threshold-linear network; explicit nonlinear Heun; stable-complex ensemble; parameter first-order theory generated separately from the transfer-derived feature map
panels.Fig2i: version-6 held-out nonlinear Heun plus two-node extension; network-specific second-order input-parameter map; condition-matched three-realization nonlinear Heun calibration; single-realization Ce
panels.Fig2j: one-to-five-node deletion states; network-specific first-order maps; two held-out nonlinear Heun realizations analysed separately before averaging correlations; single-realization Ce
panels.FigS5: complete 55-area threshold-linear 9-by-9 time-domain generator; registered forward-Euler recurrence

s2.panels: OU plus filtered oscillation, Welch PSD, FOOOF 1.1.1 and IRASA-SPLIT, second-order response surface plus calibration realization residuals; panels d-f use matched equal input-setting weights

s3.panels: linear damped oscillator and registered finite-window observation model

s4.panels: linearized finite-window Hopf observation model for population validations and explicit-Heun cubic Hopf integration for direct nonlinear trajectories

invariants: No launcher changes the model or nonlinearity.
No launcher changes input distributions or frozen parameter designs.
No launcher changes seeds, time step, burn-in, window length or Welch settings.
No launcher changes calibration/held-out allocation, validity masks, feature extraction, Taylor order or statistical aggregation.
A state-equation Jacobian, an input-parameter Taylor expansion and a complete trial-wise feature map are kept as distinct calculations.
